$comment: Shared golden vectors for the OptimizeBasisV2 canonical encoder (T08). Both core/nurse_scheduling/server/optimize_basis.py and web/lib/optimize/basis/optimize-basis.ts are tested against this exact file, so an encoder change in one language that is not mirrored in the other fails. `encoded` is the canonical text; `basisId` is the lowercase-hex SHA-256 of its UTF-8 bytes. Regenerating this file changes the identity of all retained Optimize evidence.

vectors.name: baseline plain submission, prettify false
vectors.encoded:
optimize-basis/v2
schemaVersion=i:2
submissionContractVersion=s:optimize-yaml-v1
workspaceSchemaVersion=s:1
serializerVersion=s:canonical-strict-yaml-v1
anonymizationMode=s:none
inputSha256=s:0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
normalizedOptions.solver=s:ortools/cp-sat
normalizedOptions.prettify=b:false
normalizedOptions.timeoutSeconds=i:300
solverSemanticVersion=s:ortools/cp-sat@1
backendCapabilityVersion=s:nurse-scheduling-backend@1
